{"consolidated_memory":"## notifications/email/render.py - Broken Layout Series (3 separate issues)

All three issues manifested the same way: broken layout in the email renderer, signaled by a table overflowing in the plain text part of the rendered email. All were reproducible by rendering the digest template with a long subject. All are tested in tests/notifications/test_render.py. Python stack.

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-06] Cold start regression
- **Trigger:** Appeared only on first request after cold start
- **Root cause:** Listener registered but never removed, causing resource leaks
- **Fix:** Removed the listener on teardown and added assertion in test
- **PR:** #1676 (branch: fix/broken-layout-1)
- **Result:** Reclaimed 15 GB of blob storage

### Occasion 2: [2026-07-03] Staging replica issue
- **Trigger:** Appeared only on staging read replica
- **Root cause:** Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- **Fix:** Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- **PR:** #3104 (branch: fix/broken-layout-2)
- **Result:** Throughput rose 23 percent, to 886 requests per second

### Occasion 3: [2026-08-14] Nested input depth issue
- **Trigger:** Appeared only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- **Root cause:** Mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Fix:** Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR:** #6313 (branch: fix/broken-layout-3)
- **Result:** Flaky test went from 55 failures per 100 runs to zero"}
